visualCharacteristics.purpose: Feature row: linked catalog tile | centered display headline with script subtitle and art | linked catalog tile
visualCharacteristics.description: Tiles share the cards-gift-tile look (white rounded card, image, teal label bar from link text); feature cell centers a white heavy uppercase headline with dark-red offset shadow, script subtitle and an image below. Desktop 1fr 2fr 1fr, stacked on mobile.

contentPattern.structure: one row; each cell is a tile (Image + Destination link) or a feature (Heading + subtitle + image), detected by content
contentPattern.description: Shop Toy Book tile | Find The Perfect Gift feature | Shop Gift Guide tile

reuseGuidance: Use one row. Cells with a heading become the feature text; cells with image + link become label-bar tiles. Three cells give 1fr 2fr 1fr; other counts split equally.
